name: Mine a Brainrot
desc:
Welcome to Mine a Brainrot!

How to Play:
⛏️ Dig for Lucky Blocks!
🏃 Return them to your base safely!
💸 Collect money from hatched Brainrots!
🛠️ Buy new Pickaxes and show off your SUPER rare Brainrots!
🌟 Rebirth to unlock cool new perks!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
